metadata.description: Deploy websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent — static hosting with every site at its own address (<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app), a per-site backend (shared JSON state, collections; visitor sign-in and owner-only private lists on the site's own address, agents with an API key), connect your own domain (subdomain or apex), and built-in visitor analytics.

plugins.name: simple-host
plugins.description: Describe a website and it goes online at its own address. Claude builds the site and publishes it to simple-host.app through the Simple Host connector: pages, a small shared backend for saves and sign-ups, visitor analytics, and your own domain when you want one.

plugins.name: website-deploy
plugins.description: Superseded by the simple-host plugin (Simple Host) — install that one instead; it bundles these same skills plus the Simple Host connector. Kept so existing installs keep updating. Deploy static websites to simple-host.app from your coding agent (inline JSON or tar.gz/zip). Every site lives at its own address, https://<site>.<handle>.simple-host.app/, and gets a per-site backend (shared JSON state with atomic ops, append-only collections) and built-in server-side visitor analytics, and can be connected to your own custom domain — subdomain via CNAME or apex via A record. Pages and public lists are readable by anyone; visitors sign in with Google or an emailed code before saving from a page, and a collection can be made private so only the owner reads it; agents write with an API key anywhere. Bundles a builder skill (plan what to build) and a connect-domain skill.
